This is ordering a directed graph so every edge points forwards. What's that called, and when is it impossible?
Topological sort. With Kahn's algorithm: count each course's unmet prerequisites (its in-degree); start with every course that has none.

Build adjacency lists from prerequisite to course and an in-degree array. Queue every course with in-degree 0; pop one, append it to the order, and decrement its neighbors' in-degrees, queuing any that reach 0. If the order has fewer than num_courses courses, there's a cycle: return [].
